## Objective

Complete the final implementation boundary of Repository Step 15 with a bounded real-process no-orphan acceptance. Create a Party through the public gateway of a real crm-api process, establish an accepted production-shaped Party privacy owner-action state/event while the process is stopped, remove authoritative Customer 360 v2 derived state and retain a stale legacy v1 document, then restart the real crm-api binary and prove its production background worker automatically restores the non-disclosing v2 tombstone. Execute the process acceptance on clean and rollback/reapplied PostgreSQL schemas through the existing Customer Privacy Owner Execution gate. This packet does not change owner-action, projection, query, contract, migration or worker semantics and does not synchronize final Step 15 acceptance evidence into normative planning documents.
